description:
Link a task to a roadmap milestone, or unassign it. ticket accepts a UUID, ticket slug, or full browser task URL (property optional when ticket is a URL). milestone accepts a milestone id or slug on the same board; omit milestone (or pass an empty string) to unassign the task from any milestone. A task belongs to at most one milestone.

Cost: 2 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// assign a task to the Q3 milestone.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","ticket":"fix-favicon-on-homepage","milestone":"q3-launch"}
```
name: assign_task_to_milestone
title: Assign task to milestone
